blocks.text: Sabrina Carpenter, Margaret Qualley as well as Talia Ryder have joined the cast of the upcoming Fred Astaire biopic, which will feature Tom Holland as the legendary film actor and dancer. Carpenter will portray the role of Ginger Rogers, Fred’s co-star and dance partner; while Qualley is set to play Adele Astaire, Fred’s older sister. Ryder was cast to portray June Allyson, a fellow dancer and MGM actress. Paul King is at the helm of the biopic, with Steven Levenson serving as his co-writer for the screenplay.
